offers_products.reason: Offers investment management and advisory solutions, not manufactured goods or software; fund products are a service.

offers_services.reason: Manages alternative investment portfolios, co-investments and customized solutions on behalf of institutional and individual clients.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Serves family offices and individual investors, though its main clients are institutions; it says it excludes UK and EU retail.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Institutional investors such as pensions, endowments and family offices are its core clients for alternative investment solutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Asset manager earning ongoing management fees on long-term client mandates and funds.

cyclical_demand.reason: Long-term institutional mandates and fee-based assets are not easily cut, though market values affect fees.

big_ticket.reason: Clients pay recurring management fees on committed capital, not a single large purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Clients pay for investment professionals' skill in selecting managers and building portfolios.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are large institutional investors such as pensions, sovereign funds and endowments.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light investment manager; it needs no plants, fleets or networks to grow.

notes: The website text doesn't say how revenue splits between institutions and individuals; institutions are assumed to be the larger part.
